t: A five-channel radio receiver that points toward where a signal comes from.
steps: Buy the KrakenSDR from the KrakenRF store or a European radio shop.
Get a Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5, a microSD card, and a 5 volt supply of at least 2.4 amps.
Get a short, high-quality USB-C data cable for the radio.
Flash the ready-made KrakenSDR image from the docs wiki onto the card.
Set up five matched antennas in a circle of known size.
Connect power and data, then boot the Pi.
Open the web interface in a browser on the same network.
Tune to a known local signal, such as a handheld radio, and watch the bearing arrow.
meta: Open Code. From $749. A few stores.
